_comment: HYDRA v1.0 HEDGE head — the hedge. Single-coin (config.coin / HYDRA_COIN), SHORT-only: fires ONLY when a confirmed 4h downtrend AND a fast-drawdown signal agree (peak-to-current drawdown over stressLookback 4h candles >= stressDropPct, or the 1h is breaking down), with a capitulation guard (don't short below rsiOversold). Idle (tiny bleed) in uptrends; cushions the long heads during the flip. One position per wallet. Pairs with the core + dip heads on SEPARATE wallets, same HYDRA_COIN. Set wallet/strategyId/chatId (and HYDRA_COIN or coin). Runtime owns position tracking, caps, DSL via runtime-hedge.yaml. Producer launched with HYDRA_LEG=hedge.
_coin_note: This is the Hydra-SOL variant (HYDRA_COIN=SOL). hedge stressDropPct 10 — wider than ETH (SOL is more volatile). One of three head wallets (core/dip/hedge); all three share this HYDRA_COIN. Same engine across all coins.
_role_note: HEDGE = the protector, gated to confirmed-downtrend + fast-drawdown only, SHORT only, capitulation-guarded so it never shorts an exhausted bottom. It is episodic by design — most ticks in an uptrend it does NOTHING (the tiny bleed is the cost of insurance). It exists to cushion the core+dip long heads while a break is still unfolding. Lowest leverage of the three (short squeezes are violent). Fund default sizing: core 50% / dip 25% / hedge 25%.
_persona: Single-coin stress hedge — short-only, fires on confirmed-downtrend + fast drawdown, capitulation-guarded, tight quick-lock DSL. The hedge head of a Hydra single-coin portfolio fund.
